name: gradient-aurora
description: 极光渐变底 + 居中大字
css: #tpl-gradient-aurora { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0a1a, #16213e 45%, #0f3460 80%, #1a1a2e); } #tpl-gradient-aurora .ga-text { font-size: 110px; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6d8bff, #3ecf8e, #8b6dff); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; text-align: center; padding: 0 7%; } #tpl-gradient-aurora .ga-sub { font-size: 30px; color: #9aa4c8; margin-top: 34px; }
